Many thanks to Alienware for sponsoring this video. To learn more about Alienware’s 39-inch 5K OLED Gaming Monitor, check it out here: https://aw.gg/AW3926QW

A packed Direct this week as the panel discuss the pros and cons of DLSS for Nintendo first party games like The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time. Meanwhile, HDR experts aren't too impressed by Nintendo's HDR implementations, Rich takes time to test out the Xbox FSR demo on PC and God of War Laufey gets a three month delay. And looking back in time, the panel has praise for EA's 30th anniversary game package, it's 20 years since the launch of Nvidia's 8800 GTX and a decade since John posted his epic Tomb Raider DF Retro episode. And finally, hilarity as Rich discovers how old Oliver was when Tomb Raider first released...
